description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

Key Responsibilities
 

 Research, design, build, monitor, and enhance secure websites across multiple content management systems and modern frameworks.

 Collaborate directly with the Sponsor to conceptualize, write, and produce engaging web and blog content tailored to diverse topics and audiences.

 Develop and maintain front-end and server-side code utilizing CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.

 Implement modern encryption algorithms to mitigate website vulnerabilities, protect data in transit/at rest, and harden cloud and web hosting environments.

 Deploy, configure, and maintain CMS platforms (such as WordPress), including basic hosting setup and functionality expansion via commercial plugins.

 Monitor and analyze web traffic, server logs, and analytics to optimize platform performance and ensure dependable user insights.

 Communicate technical concepts clearly through written website content, briefings, and documentation for non-technical stakeholders.




Required Experience/Clearance
 

 Active TS/SCI security clearance (polygraph eligibility preferred).

 5+ years of professional web design and development experience.

 Demonstrated experience with web design and general principles of the Internet.

 Demonstrated experience with WordPress, including setting up a basic hosting environment, installing WordPress, building a WordPress site, and adding functionality via commercially available plugins.

 Demonstrated experience writing copy for websites and blogs, with the ability to adapt and create content for websites across various topics or industries.

 Demonstrated experience using Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), JavaScript, and PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor).

 Demonstrated experience mitigating website vulnerabilities and hardening website and cloud environment security.

 Demonstrated experience implementing modern encryption algorithms into software applications.

 Demonstrated experience understanding and conveying technical concepts and language to a non-technical audience via website content development, briefings, or print material.




Desired Experience
 We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

  


 Demonstrated experience with other web development frameworks and site builders, including GoDaddy’s website builder, Joomla, Wix, Express.js, Next.js, or similar platforms.

 Demonstrated experience with website penetration testing and "red teaming" practices.

 Demonstrated experience with common digital tools such as email marketing platforms, social media marketing/management tools, and advanced website analytics.

 Relevant industry certifications in web development, cloud hosting, or cybersecurity (e.g., CompTIA Security+, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner).


The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.
 
Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.
 
If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting Talent Acquisition at Talent-Acquisition@redhorsecorp.com
 
Redhorse Corporation shall, in its discretion, modify or adjust the position to meet Redhorse’s changing needs. This job description is not a contract and may be adjusted as deemed appropriate in Redhorse’s sole discretion.
